<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the dominant ion is at m/z 180.0423, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈179.035 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass within a few ppm is C₇H₅N₃O₃ (C7H5O3N3 in the required CxHyOzX format).</thought>
<final_answer>C7H5O3N3</final_answer>
